item.title: SUV driver escapes after Coronado police chase ends in Hillcrest
item.description: A short-lived police chase involving an SUV ended when the vehicle plowed into a fence and went down an embankment in Hillcrest.

item.title: Shared basketball journey has long united SDSU sophomore, coach dad
item.description: The game runs in the family of Bailey Barnhard, the daughter of Maranatha Christian coach and USD alum Brooks Barnhard,

item.title: He spent 7 weeks in ICE detention. Why his case shows new legal obstacles for immigrants
item.description: A Department of Homeland Security budget document from 2024 says it costs on average $217 per day for ICE to detain someone in San Diego.

item.title: California scores poorly in children’s health and education, report card finds
item.description: California failed in adult-to-student ratios in classrooms and early intervention and special education.

item.title: Star ‘Chucky’ Lozano out after one season with SDFC
item.description: Lozano was one of the five highest paid footballers in the league last year at $7.6 million, but was suspended in the fall and then benched.

item.title: San Diego has the second-highest combined housing and transportation costs among major U.S. metros
item.description: San Diego is near the top of the U.S. in the share of annual spending that goes to housing. It's near the top in transportation spending too.

item.title: New mural between Barrio Logan, Logan Heights reclaims bridge as canvas for community history
item.description: Revitalization of a bridge over the I-5, connecting Barrio Logan and Logan Heights, is bringing new life to the structure.

item.title: Judge sentences rapper to time served in 2023 San Diego arrest
item.description: Hatch was initially charged by the San Diego County District Attorney's Office. Federal prosecutors eventually took up the rapper's case

item.title: Governor proposes 2026-27 California budget with significantly lower deficit
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom proposed a state budget for the fiscal year beginning July 1 with a $2.9 billion deficit, an amount significantly lower than projected.

item.title: Judge: Trump officials can’t block child care, other federal funds for California, 4 states
item.description: In filings and a hearing, the states contended that the government did not have a legal reason for holding back the money
